<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:8:3">Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ</cite> <he>יַבְשַׁת ידיה</he> his hand withered.

<cite ref="Gittin 69b:11">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>כי היכי דיביש הדא ידא וכ׳</he> (read <he>דיְבִישַׁת</he>) as this hand (of the dead man) is withered, so may the milt of … dry (shrink to its normal size); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 2:10">Targ. Josh. II, 10</cite>.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:22">Targ. Prov. XVII, 22</cite>; a. e.—Gitt. l. c. <he>ונְיַיבְּשִׁינְהוּ בטולא</he> and let him dry them (the leeches) in the shade; a. e.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 8:14">Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 14</cite>; a. e.—
